'''Fotia's Fire''' was a projectile [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] mounted on the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] used by the [[Tof Kingdom]], the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] of the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The projectile splashed [[Temperature/Legends|superheated]] glowing slime and [[Fire/Legends|burned]] a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] on impact. The Tof [[Royal Fortune-class light clipper|''Royal Fortune''-class light clipper]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] possessed<ref name="TUR" /> a [[Fotia's Fire launcher]].<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-unknown-regions.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions|date=2010-04-20|quote=The Royal Fortune light clipper also carries a secret weapon, one "Fotia's Fire launcher." This is based on [[Wikipedia:Greek fire|Greek Fire]], used in ship-to-ship battles many centuries ago and believed to have been similar in composition to napalm.}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Fotia's Fire was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The Tof weapon<ref name="TUR" /> was based on the [[Wikipedia:Greek fire|Greek Fire]], an antiquated real-world weapon used in naval warfare.<ref name="Endnotes" />
